task.description: Produce a backend design artefact at src/design/idn-02-group-management.md for requirement IDN-02 (Group management). Define the group domain model, membership join model, public API contracts for creating groups and managing members, idempotent add-member semantics, list-members pagination, and the task-claim integration rule for GROUP assignees so any ACTIVE member may claim an assigned task. Capture module boundaries across identity registry/service and task claim logic, specify migration impact (tables, constraints, indexes), list error taxonomy and HTTP mappings, and trace every acceptance criterion to at least one design element. No source code changes in this step.
acceptance_criteria: Every IDN-02 acceptance criterion is mapped to an explicit design element
Group and membership types, invariants, and API contracts are fully specified
Idempotent add-member semantics and non-existent user handling are explicit
Task claim behavior for GROUP assignees and ACTIVE membership is specified
Migration impact lists tables, columns, constraints, and indexes
Open questions or scope boundaries are listed instead of being implied
